profile: mathematical optimization: In machine learning, optimization is the search for parameters of a learning model via well-defined mathematical functions. It is the study of computational methods for minimizing formal mathematical functions. Because these methods address the search for model parameters, the tools of mathematical optimization play a fundamental role throughout machine learning.
